description: This file defines the Data Access Object (DAO) class `AccessFlowStateMachineDao` for interacting with workflow state machine records related to access control within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for querying, saving, deleting, and updating workflow states, actions, and roles in the database.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing workflow state machine records, providing CRUD operations and query methods for workflow transitions, permissions, and states.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves permitted actions for a given workflow, state, and role. Returns an array of WorkflowStateMachine objects or null if none found.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Fetches workflow items based on workflow name, state, and role. Returns an array of WorkflowStateMachine objects.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Finds the next state in the workflow for a given current state, role, and action. Returns a WorkflowStateMachine object or null.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Retrieves states actionable by a specific role for a workflow and a list of actions. Returns an array of WorkflowStateMachine objects or null.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a WorkflowStateMachine entity to the database.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Saves an array of WorkflowStateMachine entities and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on workflow, state, role, action, and resulting state. Returns true if deletion was successful.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes all workflow records associated with a specific role and optionally a workflow.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates the role name in existing workflow state machine records when a user role is renamed.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Fetches all allowed states for recruitment applications for a specific workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all workflow state machine records for a given workflow and optional role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific action is permitted in the current workflow state for a role. Returns a boolean.

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Fetches a workflow state machine record by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a specific workflow state machine record based on workflow, state, action, and role.
